name: frontend-kit
description: A complete Claude Code setup for React + TypeScript frontends, in two profiles — website (TanStack Start) and dashboard (Vite + TanStack Router): skills, agents, git and live-site guards, format/lint on edit, quality gates, MCP servers, and project templates installed by /frontend-kit:setup. Arabic RTL + English first-class.
